unsafe base.
Meters = Type (Meters Int).
Choice = Type (Plus Int | Minus Int).
Rows = Type (End | RowPlus Int Rows | RowMinus Int Rows).
build n = if n <= 0 then [] else Meters n :: build (n - 1).
total xs acc = case xs of [] -> acc | m :: rest -> case m of Meters v -> total rest (acc+v).
main = xs = build 1000; _ = print (total xs 11); print (total xs 17).
